en-US.author: Sayan Pramanick
en-US.description: Local AI Document Reader & Floating Audio Pill with Kokoro Neural Voices
en-US.longDescription:
Voxify is a private, local document-to-audiobook desktop application and system-wide
floating audio pill powered by Kokoro-82M neural voice synthesis. It allows listening
to selected text across Windows with zero cloud latency and complete privacy.
en-US.name: Voxify
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed in Voxify v1.0.8

📚 Dedicated Documentation & Tutorials
- Interactive In-App Docs Tab: Integrated comprehensive documentation directly into the left sidebar navigation.
- Quick Start Guide: Clear 3-step walkthrough for instant speech triggering and audio pill controls.
- Unified Global Shortcuts: Streamlined to focus on Win + Alt + S for instant speech, Win + Alt + X for dismissal, and Win + Alt + H for replay.
- REST API Scripting Guide: Clear curl commands and headless background automation reference for developers.

🎉 License Activation Celebration
- Multi-Stage Confetti Burst: Triggered upon activating a valid license key, with interactive celebratory replay controls.
- Celebration Modal: Clear summary of lifetime entitlements, verified credentials, and instant return to reading.

🚀 Brand Consistency & Refinements
- Amber Activation Rocket: Seamless amber badge indicating when activation is required, switching to verified emerald shield once activated.
- Matching Free Tier Badge: Cohesive rocket iconography in the Membership banner.
- Optimized Assets: Deduplicated 4MB logo files, retaining a single source of truth for icons and favicons.
